<math><mtext>SiC</mtext><msub><mrow><mtext>l</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and  <math><msub><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></math>
questions.solution:
Under hydrolytic conditions, the compound used for the preparation of linear polymer and for chain termination are (CH3)2SiCl2 and (CH3)3SiCl respectively.

The hydrolysis of dimethyldichlorosilane gives dimethyl silane diol which on condensation polymerization forms a linear polymer.

The hydrolysis of trimethylchlorosilane gives trimethyl silanol which can not undergo polymerization as it contains only one -OH group so it is used for chain termination.

questions.q: Dacron is continuous filament yarn used in curtains, dress fabrics and pressure fire hoses. The reaction for preparing dacron is by the combination of which of the following?
questions.solution: The continuous filament yarn is used in curtains, dress fabrics, high-pressure fire hoses, men's shirts, and thread. The staple fiber is ideal for mixing with wool in men's and women's suits, as well as in dress fabrics, knitted wear, and washable woven sportswear.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Arrange the following polymers in an increasing order of intermolecular forces; fibre, plastic, elastomer.
questions.solution:
Elastomers or rubbers have the weakest intermolecular forces of attraction followed by plastics while fibres have the strongest forces of attraction. Thus, the increasing intermolecular forces of attraction follows the order

elastomer < plastic < fibre.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
Polyethylene is obtained from calcium carbide.

CaC2+2H2O→CaOH2+C2H2

C2H2+H2→C2H4

nC2H4→-CH2-CH2-n

Therefore, the amount of polyethylene (in kg) obtained for 64 kg CaC2 is
questions.solution:
Moles of CaC2=64×10364≅1×103

So from the balanced chemical equation, moles of C2H2= moles of C2H4

= moles of CaC2=1×103

So moles of polythene =1n×1×103

So weight of polythene =1n×1×1×28n kg

= 28 kg
